subject: Private/VPC architecture review — follow up & scheduling
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC architecture review — follow up & scheduling

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Recap: You're evaluating a Private (VPC) deployment for inference to meet data residency and network isolation requirements. Primary workloads: real-time chat, batch embeddings for search, and an internal analytics pipeline.

Main asks from your side: on-prem/VPC network diagram, KMS/HSM key flow, and expected throughput/latency targets for pilot.

Redwood next step: technical deep dive & architecture review with our infra architect to validate network constraints and sizing.

Proposed time windows for a 60–75 min architecture review (PST):
- Wed Jun 2, 10:30–11:45am
- Thu Jun 3, 2:00–3:15pm
- Fri Jun 4, 9:00–10:15am

Can you confirm which of these works (or share a couple times) and who from your infra/security team should join? I've cc'd Marissa (solutions architect) who will lead the session.

I attached our high-level private deployment deck and a standard NDA we can sign if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-private-arch-v1.pdf, acme-ma-nda.pdf

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

Participants: I will join, plus Alex Ito (network/security) and potentially Priya from infra (TBD).

Constraints: We have an on-prem firewall that restricts outbound to a small set of egress IPs; we'll need the list and options for private peering.

Compliance: We'll want to review the KMS/HSM flow and audit log retention during the call.

From the times you proposed Thu Jun 3, 2:00–3:15pm PST works best for Alex and me. If Priya confirms, she'll join as well.

One thing — can Marissa include a short agenda: network diagram, auth/key flow, throughput sizing, and next steps (pilot + PoC timeline)?

Thanks,
Sam

Thanks — happy to run the architecture review. Agenda I'll cover (30–45 min tech + 20–30 min Q&A):

1) High-level VPC/topology options (private peering, VPN, transit gateway)
2) Signal flow: request path, KV cache, and inference runtime placement
3) Auth & key management: KMS/HSM integration patterns, token/key rotation
4) Performance sizing: throughput targets, batching, and latency SLOs
5) Data governance: logs, retention, and audit hooks
6) Suggested pilot plan & next steps

I've added Dev (infra eng) to help with sizing and firewall/egress questions.

I'll bring the redwood-private-arch-v1.pdf and a short runbook. If you can share a couple of sample throughput numbers (rps, avg and p95 latency goals) ahead of time that'll help me size nodes.

Tentatively locking Thu Jun 3, 2:00pm PST — can you confirm?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
